changelog: Type-strain genomes in the app: Settings shows the offline NCBI type-strain set (genomes, size, age) and downloads or updates it with one button, with live progress; the download runs in its own session and survives a backend restart. A reminder (dot on Settings, banner on the home screen, 'remind me in 2 weeks') appears 3 months after the last full update and turns red at 6. The ONT WGS form shows whether type strains are available offline. Backend restart required.

previous.changelog: ONT-WGS offline type strains: setup_typestrains.sh downloads every NCBI type-strain genome (about 22,700 genomes in 4,600 genera, ~31 GB) into the cache the pipeline already reads, so ANIb / ANIm / TETRA, the genome tree and reference mapping run without an internet connection (--genera for a subset, --status, resumable). Reference mapping: assembly-vs-reference identity is now gap-compressed (it read 83 % for a 98 % ANI isolate because long insertions counted base by base). Console: the ONT WGS form uploads whole folders (Choose folder…), leaving fastq_fail out. Backend restart required.
